original_card.question: Can one misleading historical-current claim or missing research cross-reference be corrected?
methods: Trace one confusing path from onboarding to its authoritative source.
Index one tightly related family of obstructions with explicit excluded and open hypotheses.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Produce evidence-backed navigation, preserve historical records and avoid a duplicate global survey.

first_step.inspect: Follow one link from the selected record to its review and compare a potentially stale historical claim.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Repair one confusing path or produce a scoped map of one related obstruction family.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Clear navigation lowers entry cost for central research; a global survey without a concrete fix is not required.
allowed_variations: One historical-current ambiguity or one bounded family index.
scope_change_triggers: Rewriting frozen scientific packages just to change their historical wording.

actual_scope: Bind the selected k8 source interface to the applicability boundary of the frozen 71-record heterogeneous-owner catalogue.
scope_change_reason: Follow the selected-result manifest to its concrete inventory/profile and compare exact interfaces, including the pre-slot R480 source.
bottleneck_link: Prevents applying a historical finite-catalogue obstruction to the selected complex supplier; navigation evidence only.
stop_rule: Stop after exact source binding, catalogue membership, symbolic slot delta and three mismatching-interface controls.
evidence: RESULT.json records 25 historical interfaces, the selected source chain, and its absent exact interface.
author: woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance with source tracing, checker, proof and documentation.

open_questions.question: Can an enlarged catalogue containing the selected k8 provider support a useful obstruction?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The frozen catalogue bound does not quantify this outside provider.
open_questions.first_step: Add the exact selected inventory/profile to a new, separately named catalogue and recompute its signed dual.
open_questions.blocked_by: A new exhaustive catalogue and independently checked dual, not the historical theorem.
